Subject: MSA redlines — security exhibit / pen-test staffing questions

Hi Mina,

Thanks for sending over the MSA + order form. Attached are our legal redlines (see MedVance_MSA_redlines.docx). A few items on the security exhibit we want to confirm before we proceed:

1) Pen test staffing: we need confirmation that the vendor performing the penetration test will be mutually agreed and can provide a scope of work and CVs for lead engineers. We typically require third-party testers to have ISO27001 or CREST-equivalent certifications.

2) Audit scope: we propose a limited-scope SOC 2 type 2 evidence package that excludes customer PII systems but includes the hosting runtime and key management. Please confirm whether Redwood can carve out multi-tenant boundaries and provide sampled artifacts rather than full exports.

3) Evidence cadence: our procurement wants a predictable weekly cadence for evidence delivery during onboarding (6 weeks) and then quarterly snapshots. Is that feasible, and can you propose a lightweight cadence?

I attached a short staffing matrix (pen-test-staffing-matrix.xlsx) and an initial evidence cadence ask. If we can align on staffing and what "sampled artifacts" look like, we can move to signature.

Best,
Sarah Lin
Lead Contracts Manager
MedVance

Subject: Re: MSA redlines — security exhibit / pen-test staffing questions

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear asks and the redlines. Quick responses inline: 

1) Pen test staffing: we can provide a short list of preferred third-party vendors (we've worked with them on platform pen tests) and will share CVs for proposed leads. We can agree on mutual approval terms; REDWOOD requests 5 business days for vendor review. Certificates: most of our partners have CREST/OSCP/OSWE credentials — we will flag any deviations.

2) Audit scope & sampled artifacts: Redwood can provide a bounded sampling approach — we propose a tenant-scoped evidence bundle that includes architecture diagrams, SOC2 controls mapping, log samples (redacted), and a snapshot of configuration baselines for the components in scope. We do not provide raw DB exports. For multi-tenant systems we can provide tracing to show isolation and a small anonymized telemetry sample.

3) Evidence cadence: attached is a draft proposal (evidence-cadence-proposal.pdf). Our recommended approach: 6-week onboarding sprint (weekly drops) followed by quarterly snapshots (summary + sampled artifacts). We can also offer an optional longer retention package if you need monthly historical samples.

I'll loop in Karthik and Laura for any legal specifics on phrasing and Marissa for ops/pen-test scheduling. Can you confirm whether your counsel requires enumerated certification names in the MSA or if a general "industry standard" clause suffices?

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Manager, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence-cadence-proposal.pdf

Mina — forwarding Sarah's redlines. My read: legal will want precise language on vendor approval, evidence scope, and a carveout line to protect operational hygiene (no raw DB exports, no customer PII). Drafted a few options below for the security exhibit: 

Option A (preferred, concise): "Provider shall grant Customer access to sampled supporting evidence reasonably necessary to validate controls, to be delivered in a mutually agreed format on a cadence not to exceed quarterly. Provider will not share raw production data or full database exports. Vendor selection for penetration testing is subject to mutual approval; Provider may propose qualified vendors and will provide CVs and SOW."

Option B (more prescriptive): enumerates required tester certifications and a 10-business-day review window.

Also: Sarah's ask about certificates — if MedVance insists on enumerated certification names we should accept CREST/ISO27001/OSCP as acceptable equivalents in the doc. Otherwise keep it "industry standard" to avoid endless negotiation.

I recommend we propose Option A in our initial counter and append a schedule for a one-time pen-test scoping call (60 min) during onboarding.

--Karthik
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference

Thanks, Karthik and Mina. We reviewed the two options with counsel. They prefer Option B but are willing to accept Option A if Redwood is willing to: 

- Confirm the minimum certificate list (CREST or ISO27001) in email (we can add as "examples of acceptable certifications").
- Commit to a 7-business-day vendor approval turnaround once CVs/SOW are provided.
- Provide a sample redacted log artifact so our security team can validate the anonymization approach before contract signature.

We can accept no raw DB exports, but we need clearer language on "sampled artifacts" (what fields, how redaction is applied). Are you able to produce a one-off sample artifact within 5 business days?

If so we'll mark this green and move to countersign.

Best,
Sarah

Sarah — thanks for the clear path. We're happy to accept Option A with the following commitments (we'll include these in a short exhibit attachment to the MSA):

- Certifications: Redwood will include examples: CREST, ISO27001, OSCP as acceptable certifications for third-party testers (language: "examples of acceptable certifications").
- Vendor approval: Redwood will make best efforts to provide vendor CVs and SOWs and will respond to approval requests within 7 business days; if no objection is raised within 7 business days, the vendor will be deemed approved.
- Sample artifact: Our security team will produce one redacted log sample and a redaction methodology note within 5 business days of your written request. We will not provide raw DB exports or unredacted PII.
- Evidence cadence: Redwood will follow the 6-week onboarding weekly-drop plan and then provide quarterly snapshot packets. We will include a short evidence index that maps artifacts to SOC2 criteria.

Action items we will take now: 
1) Marissa will schedule a 60-minute scoping call next week to align on pen-test SOW boundaries and timeline.
2) Laura will prepare the exhibit language and circulate a one-page attachment for quick sign-off.
3) Security (me) will produce and deliver a redacted sample artifact by EOD next Wednesday (2026-06-10).

If that sounds good I'll ask legal to incorporate the exhibit and reissue the MSA for countersign.

Thanks,
